facts.fact: Minister Sofiene Hemissi says the Khadamet mobile app, launched end August 2026, gives access to more than forty administrative services through digital identity.

Digital identity is used across more than forty services in Khadamet, and MobileID also gives access to the Portail du citoyen for birth-extract translation requests (Interior Ministry, 31 August 2026).
The Interior Ministry presented a remote service on the Portail du citoyen reached through the MobileID digital identity on 31 August 2026.
